title: Yen Press Licenses Fate/strange Fake, Kino's Journey, Spice and Wolf Diner: Gourmet Exploration, More Manga/Novels
content:
Yen Press announced the following licenses at New York Comic Con on Friday:

A horse-drawn carriage races across the cosmos. Or rather, a spaceship made to look like one. At the helm are a pair of refugees who fled Earth after pollution rendered it uninhabitable: Ridley, a scientist and the designer of this peculiar spacecraft, and Watari, an accomplished martial artist with debilitating shyness. This eccentric duo has but one goal—to find a stable planet where they can settle down on!

However, every world the two visit is a little off… A planet with a god that can revive the dead, a planet where lucky people reign supreme, a planet lined with endless libraries… Can the girls navigate the unique challenges posed by each bizarre world and live to reach the next leg of their journey? And is there really a replacement for Earth waiting to be found among the stars?

So there I am on my death bed when a literal devil comes to make a deal with me. I get a second shot at life, and in exchange, I'm on the hook for designing the most enticing dungeon her world has ever seen. Pretty sweet deal, if you ask me. Let's see, how do we get people to explore the dungeon? How about if we offer hot springs capable of rejuvenating skin, reversing the effects of aging, and granting you crazy strength? Whoops… Looks like our baths are too popular and are causing some geopolitical strife. Well, it's just another day in the life of a dungeon master!

It has been several years since the conclusion of the Fifth Holy Grail War. Now the stage has been set for a brand-new battle in Snowfield, a city in the western United States. But this iteration of the war is built on lies. Mages and Heroic Spirits gather upon a false stage. And though they grow increasingly aware that something is amiss, they play their roles all the same. Truth and fiction no longer matter, for these competitors fight not for the Grail, but to see their personal convictions through to the end. But when the final drop of blood is shed and the battle draws to a close, what secrets will this enigmatic conflict uncover…?

So begins the story of a boy in search of a friend and a clumsy poltergeist in need of a little human kindness… The best of friendships come from the most unexpected places!

title: October’s Biggest Dark Romance Anime Drops Gorgeous New Trailer – Watch
content:
The Fall 2026 Anime season is absolutely stacked with highly-anticipated new releases, with the return of popular series like The Apothecary Diaries , Black Clover Season 2 , Blue Box Season 2 , and the return of Tokyo Revengers . There’s plenty of new series dropping as well, with romance fans hyping up the release of Firefly Wedding from David Production, the official anime adaptation of the original web manga from Oreco Tachibana. This dark, historical romance manga blew up upon its release in 2023 thanks to its doomed love story, with its leads: Satoko Kirigaya, a beautiful young woman and daughter of an earl whose life is on a time limit due to an incurable heart condition, and Shinpei Goto, a mysterious assassin initially hired to kill her before Satoko barters for her life by proposing the two get married.

With the original manga coming to an end earlier in 2026, fans of the series have been anxiously awaiting the release of the anime adaptation, and David Productions has put in the work to bring Firefly Wedding and its eccentric leading couple to life. Directed by Takahiro Kamei, the same creative mind behind 2022’s modern reboot of Rumiko Takahashi’s Urusei Yatsura , David Production’s has dropped a special character trailer of the show’s murderous heartthrob Shinpei to showcase some of his best moments in the show’s upcoming premiere.

Firefly Wedding’s New Trailer Perfectly Captures The Manga’s Heartbreaking Love Story

Shinpei’s character trailer hyping up the Firefly Wedding premiere is nothing short of perfect, showing off the character’s adorable facial expressions and tenderness toward his bride-to-be, Satoko, contrasted beautifully with his more murderous qualities interspersed throughout. Shinpei is played by Kouki Uchiyama, whose voice is slowly beginning to dominate the anime industry, taking on the role of other prominent characters like Kei Tsukishima in Haikyu!! , Shigaraki in My Hero Academia , and Toge Inumaki in Jujutsu Kaisen , as well as leading roles in other new anime slated to release throughout the remainder of 2026 into 2027, such as D in Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2 .

His voice is a perfect fit for Shinpei, a sadistic trained assassin who is capable of efficiently taking down hoards of lesser-prepared foes while reserving a peculiar softness for Satoko Kirigaya. Satoko will be played by Lynn, previously known for her roles in Mushoku Tensei as Lilia Greyart, Fire Force as Hibana, and Uma Musume as Maruzensky. With the series releasing in October 2026 as part of the Fall Anime season, there hasn’t been any hard confirmation on how far into the manga the first season of the anime plans to explore, however, those looking to watch the adaptation will be able to stream Firefly Wedding worldwide on Crunchyroll .

There’s No Other Doomed Romance Quite Like Firefly Wedding

Firefly Wedding takes place during the Meiji era and predominantly follows a stunningly beautiful young woman named Satoko Kirigaya, the daughter of an earl whose critical heart condition has sentenced her to a shortened life due to the medical care she has access to. Satoko wishes to marry into a good family in spite of her circumstances, but ends up getting kidnapped by a band of assassins. In a desperate attempt to escape, she strikes a deal with one of them: a younger man named Shinpei, to marry her and to save her from being killed. He agrees, and while Satoko initially only clings to the posessive, murderous Shinpei for a chance at survival, she ends up falling in love with him. Originally published online by Oreco Tachibana in 2023 through Shogakukan’s MangaONE before moving to Ura Sunday .

The manga exploded in popularity over its three year run, having over 5 million copies in circulation following the release of its final chapter. In 2024, Firefly Wedding won the grand prize at NTT Solmare’s Digital Comic Awards, and ranked first in the Nationwide Bookstore Employees’ Recommended Comics list that same year. This massively popular shojo series has cemented itself as a modern success for the demographic, and has quickly eclipsed Oreco Tachibana’s debut work, Promise Cinderella in popularity despite being a short series. With the release of the anime adaptation , Firefly Wedding ‘s popularity will only grow as more fans are introduced to this infamous couple.

title: 7 Years Later, Attack on Titan Director Opens Up About MAPPA’s Takeover
content:
WIT Studio was established in 2012, and the very first anime produced by the studio was Attack on Titan . Based on the award-winning manga written and illustrated by Hajime Isayama, the anime debuted in 2013 and didn’t take long before capturing viewers’ attention. While WIT is one of the most renowned animation studios in Japan right now, it faced major struggles during the production of Attack on Titan . For a new studio without any foothold in the industry, it was an incredibly ambitious project. However, there’s no denying that WIT Studio was probably the best choice for the series. The first three seasons are still praised for laying the groundwork for the story.

Whether it’s the visuals or the fluid movements, hardly any anime even now can compare to it. The anime had an exceptional run for the first three seasons, but things changed drastically after the time skip. WIT Studio wrapped up the second part of Season 3 in 2019, a couple of years before the manga reached its conclusion. The story took a drastic turn in the post-timeskip era, sparking several controversies and fan debates even after the manga’s finale in 2021. It’s been more than seven years since WIT Studio wrapped up Season 3, and the Chief Animation Director finally opens up about the unexpected change.

Attack on Titan Shares Thoughts on MAPPA’s Adaptation in Final Season

In an interview with Anime News Network , the Chief Animation Director, Tetsuro Araki, shared, “For various reasons, MAPPA took over the series. They continued it with a level of quality that didn’t fall short of ours. If anything, I think they achieved an even higher level of quality. When you look at the story as a whole, everything fits together. You can watch all of the episodes straight through.” He continued, “In the end, MAPPA brought the series to its conclusion, and that cultural legacy was completed. I think that’s an incredibly rare thing. I think Attack on Titan is a miraculous work, and I don’t think something like it will come along again very easily.”

While the first three seasons of the anime are still loved, WIT Studio had to wash its hands of the series for various reasons. Things changed completely around the time the manga was in its final stretch, which means the studio was under a tight deadline to wrap up the story as soon as possible. Although Araki didn’t open up about the reason behind the change in studio, he praised MAPPA’s adaptation. WIT Studio originally wanted the anime to become a cultural legacy, and while they did their part, it wouldn’t have been possible if MAPPA’s adaptation wasn’t equally as amazing . While WIT Studio initially faced difficulties over its next flagship title, things turned out for the better when Spy x Family was introduced. Spy x Family is another acclaimed Shonen Jump series, and the anime is a collaborative project between WIT Studio and CloverWorks.

MAPPA Is Planning a Major Return for Attack on Titan Fans

At this point, the anime can’t continue since the manga never returned with a new chapter or any sequel after wrapping things up. Isayama dealt with severe stress and even health issues when the manga was in its final stretch. Things only got worse due to the extreme criticism from fans, which might be another reason why he never returned with an extra or even a new story, even now. However, both animation studios often revive the anime in theatres with new versions of the already released episodes or compilations, but that’s all we can expect from the anime right now.

September 9th has been declared as the official Attack on Titan Day, which means the franchise will reveal new updates every year while commemorating this special day. Not only that, MAPPA will adapt the final storyline for the upcoming game, Attack on Titan 3 . The game will be released on December 10th, 2026, which gives fans something new to look forward to by the end of the year. Additionally, the series is also listed among the MAPPA projects that will be displayed during the 15th anniversary Expo.

title: Ize Press Announces Print Editions of Regas, Eat Before You Go Webtoons
content:
Ize Press announced two new Korean webtoon titles, Regas and Eat Before You Go , at the Yen Press Industry Panel at New York Comic-Con on Friday.

Regas , illustrated by Daengmeong and adapted by Lee kkeut from the original story by samk, is an ongoing fantasy BL webtoon set in a kingdom where the royal bloodline inherits the blessings of a dragon.

The story follows a powerful crown prince whose supernatural abilities have come at the cost of his sanity. Abel, a Regas trained to tame coldhearted monarchs, is tasked with caring for the prince and gradually tries to teach him about the world around him amid growing political turmoil.

The webtoon has more than two million views across Lezhin , Tappytoon , Manta , and Tapas .

Ize Press also announced Eat Before You Go , illustrated by "the Bichon" and adapted by Kim Haema from the original story by Ko Doo Yeol.

The fantasy webtoon follows Miro Laikas, a hero who returns to Earth after spending 30 years defeating a demon lord, only to discover that his home is now overrun with monsters. Rather than continuing his life as a hero, Miro opens a restaurant and uses monster parts as ingredients for his cooking.

Published digitally on WEBTOON , Eat Before You Go has more than eight million views. The series combines fantasy, cooking, and slice-of-life elements, with Miro running his restaurant, raising a baby dragon, and occasionally fighting powerful enemies.

Ize Press has not yet announced release dates or preorder information for either title.

title: Firefly Wedding Manga Gets Live-Action Adaptation on TV in 2027
content:
The official website for the television anime of Oreko Tachibana 's Firefly Wedding ( Hotaru no Yomeiri ) manga announced on Saturday that the manga is getting a live-action adaptation on Fuji TV in 2027. The website streamed a video, but it is not available in the U.S.

Viz Media publishes the manga in English, and it describes the story:

On the surface, Satoko has it all—she's beautiful, the daughter of a nobleman, and at a prime age for marriage. Unfortunately, she is also quite ill and only has a short time left to live. Before she can secure a marriage that will redeem her worth in her family's eyes, she finds herself the target of the mysterious assassin Shinpei, and her plans are put in jeopardy. In order to save herself, she makes a desperate proposal—of marriage! When it comes to love, however, Shinpei takes “until death do we part” seriously.

Tachibana launched the manga on Shogakukan 's Manga ONE app in January 2023, and ended it on January 12. Shogakukan published the 12th compiled book volume on June 19, and will release the 13th and final volume on October 19. A volume of spinoff chapters will launch on the same day.

title: Avatar: Seven Havens Just Confirmed Two More Seasons
content:
Today marks the first time in twelve years that a new animated TV series in the Avatar: The Last Airbender franchise has arrived, as the first three episodes of Avatar: Seven Havens have officially arrived on Paramount+. Telling an all-new story in the timeline and set hundreds of years after the events of Avatar: The Last Airbender and The Legend of Korra , Seven Havens has already distinguished itself in a major way from what came before it. Fans got even more good news about the series today, though, in addition to its premiere, as its future was just officially confirmed.

A second season of Avatar: Seven Havens has already been confirmed, but straight from New York Comic Con today was word about even more. During the franchise panel today, Avatar: The Last Airbender co-creators Michael Dante DiMartino and Bryan Konietzko officially confirmed that Avatar: Seven Havens has already been renewed for Seasons 3 and 4, meaning the next books in the series are officially happening. Every episode of Book 1, telling the story of Avatar Pavi and her twin sister Nisha, will roll out over the course of October , with details on Books 2, 3 and 4 set to follow later.

Avatar: Seven Havens Confirms Two More Seasons

Suffice to say, fans were shocked to find out that Avatar: Seven Havens has already been renewed for more episodes so early. In response to the news, one user wrote : “Renewed for Seasons 3 and 4 before Season 1 can even prove itself? 😭💀 Paramount+ is either cooking something legendary or setting us up for the biggest disappointment ever.” Another added : “Double renewal before season 1 even airs is a flex but also kind of terrifying for the animation team’s sleep schedule.”

It’s worth noting that, as of this writing, even though only eight reviews are present, Avatar: Seven Havens currently holds a 100% rating on Rotten Tomatoes. That means two things on the whole about the series: not only is it a show of confidence by the studio to allow the Avatar team to continue what they’re doing and roll through so fresh episodes can drop more regularly, but it also means that Paramount is making sure to cement the fact that Avatar as a franchise is part of the bread and butter of the studio’s future (now a full juggernaut after the acquisition of Warner Bros.).

Avatar: Seven Havens is already set to make some bold swings for the franchise. Part of that is by placing itself hundreds of years after the last series, which means that it will be set against the backdrop of a post-apocalyptic world that’s been seemingly destroyed by Korra . The new Avatar, named Pavi, is confirmed to be an Earthbender who becomes the Avatar and travels the world with her twin sister.

With the first three episodes of Book 1 streaming now on Paramount+, the rest of the season will arrive over the course of the month. Episodes 4 to 6 will premiere on Friday, October 16, followed by Episodes 7 through 9 on Friday, October 23, and the final batch, Episodes 10 through 13, on Friday, October 30.

title: Avatar Studios Confirms New Series for Fan-Favorite Avatar (First Look Revealed)
content:
Straight from New York Comic Con, Avatar: The Last Airbender co-creators Michael Dante DiMartino and Bryan Konietzko have confirmed that the franchise is expanding yet again. Fresh off the success of Avatar Aang: The Last Airbender , the team at Avatar Studios has been steadily expanding the series to give it an even bigger footprint, with new characters and stories that make the mythology even bigger. The next chapter of these will be Avatar: Seven Havens , but they’re not stopping there, with another all-new series confirmed at the con.

Avatar Kuruk: Wave of Chaos was confirmed by Avatar Studios at NYCC, revealing it as the next animated series in the works for the Paramount+ streaming service. A first look at the show, telling the backstory of the Water Tribe Avatar Kuruk from the franchise lore, got a first look for the crowd in attendance, and the images have made their way online, including his pet Nikik. According to the official description, Avatar Kuruk: Wave of Chaos follows the “rebellious teenage Avatar” who bucks thousands of years of tradition by choosing to learn the four elements through globetrotting adventures, staying one step ahead of his angry teacher, rowdy pirates, and chaotic spirits – all while helping the world in his own unique ways. Check it out below.

Avatar Kuruk: Wave of Chaos First Look Revealed

Most of Kuruk’s appearances across the Avatar franchise have been as visions, with details of his story seeded across media and featuring surprising elements. Among them is that his lifespan as an Avatar is actually the shortest, meaning that there’s only so much runway to explore, but given the series will focus on his early days, there’s a lot to work with at the start of the journey compared to the end of the road. The upcoming series is produced by Avatar Studios and Nickelodeon Animation Studios, with co-creator Bryan Konietzko serving as showrunner.

News of Avatar Kuruk: Wave of Chaos (along with confirmation about the future of Avatar: Seven Havens ) had fans of the franchise stoked about its prospects, not only the continued expansion of the series itself but also in telling Kuruk’s story.

“A teenage Kuruk surfing, fighting pirates, and slacking off on his training is the most lore-accurate thing they could have possibly done,” one user wrote. Another added , “Finally, The Avatar franchise was always meant to be done backwards, not forward. Kyoshi next.” Finally, one Avatar fan said what we were all thinking about the Kurk show’s timing, writing online: “They making another one after just dropping the new series? Wild they didn’t make us wait 10 years again 💀”

Avatar Kuruk: Wave of Chaos is currently without a release date, but expect more details to arrive in the near future as the franchise is clearly becoming a key pillar of Paramount’s new entertainment landscape.

title: Manga 'Hotaru no Yomeiri' Gets Live-Action Adaptation in 2027
content:
Television broadcast company Fuji TV announced a live-action adaptation of Oreco Tachibana 's Hotaru no Yomeiri ( Firefly Wedding ) web manga on Saturday, revealing an announcement promotional video. The live-action series is scheduled to premiere on Fuji TV in 2027.

Tachibana began drawing the historical romance manga on the MangaONE platform in January 2023. The 12th volume was released on June 19, with the 13th and final volume scheduled for release on October 19.

The television anime is produced by David Production and began airing on October 9. Crunchyroll is simulcasting the series with English subtitles.

Comikey began publishing the series in English in June 2023. Viz Media licensed the series in May 2024. The seventh volume went on sale on July 14, with the eighth volume scheduled to be released on October 13.

Synopsis Satoko, the eldest daughter of the honorable Kirigaya family, has received many marriage proposals from men captivated by her beauty and grace. However, she has turned them all down due to her secret heart defect. Despite her condition, Satoko is still willing to find a husband to ease her beloved father's concerns.

While on a stroll, Satoko is kidnapped by a group of mercenaries, one of them being Shinpei Gotou—a legendary assassin tasked with executing her. Satoko tries to bribe Gotou into freeing her, but it proves unsuccessful. Out of options, Satoko makes a desperate gamble: under the pretense of love at first sight, she asks him to marry her.

Unexpectedly, Gotou takes the bait and vows to protect her. As the couple escapes to freedom, Satoko struggles to keep up the ruse and make sense of the mysterious man she has eloped with. [Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Casshern R Manga Listed as Ending With 3rd Volume
content:
Retailers are listing the third compiled book volume of Satoshi Shiki 's Casshern R manga — the adaptation of Tatsunoko Production 's Shinzō Ningen Casshan original television anime — as the final volume. The volume will ship on December 18.

The manga's story centers on Tetsuya Azuma, who transforms into Casshern to fight mankind's enemy Andro and his army.

The manga first launched in Monthly Champion RED in September 2023. Chabo Higurashi is writing the manga's script. Satoshi announced in November 2023 the manga's move from Monthly Champion RED to Akita Shoten 's Manga Cross website. The manga restarted its serialization on the website from the fourth chapter in April 2025.

Tatsunoko Production 's Shinzō Ningen Casshan original anime first aired in Japan in 1973. The anime's Casshan: Robot Hunter animated video remake released in Japan in 1993, and Kazuaki Kiriya 's live-action movie remake released in 2004. Streamline Pictures and ADV Films both released Casshan: Robot Hunter in North America, and Go Fish Pictures released the Casshern live-action movie remake.

The anime's latest remake titled Casshern Sins aired in Japan in 2008. Funimation streamed the anime with English subtitles, and also released it on Blu-ray Disc and DVD in North America.

Shiki ended his Akuma Kōjo ( The Devil Princess ) manga, the adaptation of Biyori Harunohi 's original story, in May 2024. The manga launched in Kodansha 's Monthly Shonen Sirius magazine in May 2022. Kodansha published the manga's third and final compiled book volume in August 2024.

Shiki ( XBlade , XBlade Cross , Daphne in the Brilliant Blue ) ended the Attack on Titan: Before the Fall manga in March 2019.

Seven Seas Entertainment is releasing Shiki's The Legend of Dororo and Hyakkimaru ( Dororo to Hyakkimaru -den ) remake manga of Osamu Tezuka 's Dororo manga in English. Shiki launched the manga in Monthly Champion RED magazine in October 2018.

title: Crunchyroll’s Highly Anticipated Ghost of Tsushima Anime Gets Bad News
content:
Earlier this year, at a press conference held by Crunchyroll , it was announced that Sucker Punch’s Ghost of Tsushima video game would receive a new anime adaptation titled Ghost of Tsushima: Legends . It was exciting news, and fans were thrilled to see another video game franchise receive an expanded vision. Among the many details announced, it was also revealed that the anime was aiming for a 2027 release window. However, new information has just been unveiled at New York Comic Con, pushing back the release date.

To be specific, the upcoming Ghost of Tsushima anime adaptation is now aiming for a 2028 release window. Additionally, new cast members for the anime have been announced, including Mayumi Saco and Shinya Fukumatsu, although their roles have yet to be revealed. That said, Saco is known for playing Tomoe in the game, while Shinya is known for his many roles in the anime industry, including Bomb in One-Punch Man . Although the anime has been delayed, the additional cast details hint that development is moving forward rather than the project being backlogged or cancelled.

Crunchyroll’s Ghost of Tsushima Anime Adaptation Is Aiming Big Despite the Delay

The details revealed for the anime so far have only reinforced that the project is aiming for high quality. This stems from the involvement of anime studio Kamikaze Douga, known for creating Star Wars: Visions’ “The Duel” and Batman Ninja , with Takanobu Mizuno, the director of the former, also returning for Ghost of Tsushima ‘s upcoming anime adaptation. This already gives the anime the potential to stand out, while the additional information hints that voice actors like Saco could be returning to reprise their roles, with more details potentially being unveiled in the future. Meanwhile, the source material also hints at how this anime could evolve in different directions.

Specifically, the anime’s title is Ghost of Tsushima: Legends , based on the expansion featuring multiple interesting characters, each with their own legends and unique strengths. However, the anime project has also hinted at capturing Jin Sakai’s main storyline, as suggested by a statement revealed earlier. This makes the upcoming anime particularly intriguing, especially given the visual teaser released earlier this year. Specifically, it features three characters, clearly suggesting that the story won’t focus solely on a lone samurai taking on the Mongol Empire but will instead follow multiple characters, potentially with three leading protagonists.

Based on what has been revealed, these legends could include Jin Sakai, Yuna, and, given the latest voice actor addition, Tomoe, Sensei Ishikawa’s legendary star pupil who rebels against the empire in her own way. With multiple storylines, the series could weave together the legends of these three characters into an original story built on the game’s foundation. Ultimately, Ghost of Tsushima has the potential to stand out as a video game anime adaptation thanks to its narrative possibilities. While the latest delay is unfortunate, it could give the project more time to become refined and complete before it begins streaming on Crunchyroll in 2028.
